snippet.title: Eclipsium — Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/2419670

Eclipsium launches on September 19, 2025.

Longing for light, a sunless world begins devouring itself. Every step shifts the landscape beneath you as you search for what remains of her.
